resolution.note: memory-refs reads tasks/archive/*.jsonl first; real memory MISSING-TASK 48 -> 0; test/claude/memory-refs.test.ts red before, green after

title: Memory-refs resolves archived tasks
body:
Outcome: scripts/claude/memory-refs.ts resolves task ids archived by krn task archive (tasks/archive/*.jsonl), so archived tasks are not reported MISSING-TASK.
Why: after S17 (c524955) archived 731 closed tasks, memory-refs reported 48 false MISSING-TASK findings on the operator memory and the session start named 9 stale notes.
Proof: node --test test/claude/memory-refs.test.ts: pass with an archived task reported STALE-TASK, not MISSING-TASK; the real memory check drops from 48 MISSING-TASK to 0.
